messages:
miguel: removed the dead feature flag `enable_legacy_shard` and addressed the comments from earlier review. PTAL when you get a sec — this unblocks the shard allocator cleanup. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821

sarah: thanks — quick q: the migration script — will this cause any rolling restarts or perf blips during canary?

miguel: good question. no rolling restarts. I made the migration idempotent and it runs as a job on a single control plane replica. it's behind the canary toggle so traffic won't flip until ops flips the flag. command I ran locally: ```kubectl apply -f infra/migrations/remove_enable_legacy_shard.yaml```

raj: small nit: can you add an entry in CHANGES.md referencing the migration and why we removed the flag? also saw a flaky test in allocator_integration — I pushed a tiny timing guardfix to the test.

miguel: added CHANGES.md entry and fixed the test (CI green now: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/4821). PTAL again for the changelog + test fix.

caroline: quick infra eyes: looks safe from infra side. left one doc nit about the rollout steps, but otherwise :thumbsup:.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @miguel for 2025-01-15 18:00 UTC — job #canary-4821 queued.

miguel: pushed the doc tweak @caroline, thanks. PTAL final tiny wording change when you have a moment.

caroline: LGTM, approving now.

miguel: thanks all — merging in ~5m and will monitor the canary. ping me if anything pops up.
